sql.note.insertNote: insert into flow.note(parent_id, created_by_id, note) values (:parentId, :userId, :note)
sql.note.getNote: select n.id, n.note, n.parent_id, n.date_created, n.date_modified, n.created_by_id, n.archived, concat(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS created_by, n.modified_by_id from flow.note n inner join flow.user creator on creator.id = n.created_by_id where n.id = :id
sql.note.updateNote: update flow.note set note = :note, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.note.deleteNote: update flow.note set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :noteId
